At Ralph Gracie Pleasanton, we are dedicated to serving our community through teaching martial arts and life skills. We believe in cultivating strong, confident, focused and respectful individuals that empower themselves and others.

Join us today for a complimentary 3 day trial class and experience our classes, culture and what it is to be a part of our family. Our classes take place throughout an open schedule, so there is time for everyone.

Contact us today to learn more!

Ralph Gracie is a former no-holds-barred fighter and jiu-jitsu competitor, as well as the founder of the Ralph Gracie Academy, an association with multiple gyms around the world. Ralph is also a member of the Gracie Family, a family well known for its close relationship with martial arts and grappling in particular, and the grandson of Gracie Jiu-Jitsu founder Carlos Gracie; son of Master Robson Gracie and brother to the legendary Renzo Gracie and Ryan Gracie.

In No Gi Jiu-Jitsu, you don't wear the traditional uniform. Instead, you wear shorts and a t-shirt or rash guard. In the No Gi form of BJJ, you can't grab your opponent's clothing to increase leverage. In No Gi, there are more wrestling-based grips such as collar ties, wrist grabs and joint controls. Not surprisingly, it is harder to control an opponent without the Gi as they can slip or power out of many controls, especially when slippery from sweat. As a result of having less ability to control your opponent with grips, No Gi Jiu-Jitsu is a faster-paced form of grappling.

Brazilian Jiu Jitsu is a predominantly ground-based martial art, using the principals of leverage, angles, pressure and timing, as well as knowledge of the human anatomy, in order to achieve a submission of one's opponent. Unlike other martial arts that focus on strikes and/or kicks, jiu jitsu focuses on close-contact "grappling" holds and techniques, and the application of chokes and joint-manipulations.

Our conditioning class offers an intense allover workout, that is intended to benefit you in all of our BJJ, No Gi and Muay Thai classes. You will use multiple different techniques to work on cardio and strength. Eventhough our conditioning class is designed around benefitting you in our other classes, it is also a great class for those who are just interested in getting into shape. This is why we also offer a slightly less intense version of our conditioning class during our 5:45pm kids class, on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so that parents who are waiting for their children are able to join in.

Other than variations of punches as seen in western boxing (e.g. jabs, crosses, hooks, uppercuts), kicks, elbows and knee strikes are used in Muay Thai. Clinching, sweeps and throws are also used strategically in modern Muay Thai to make it an all-rounded combat art. Due to the 8-point contact, the sport has proven to be one of the most effective stand-up striking art and is practised by many mixed martial artists.

At Ralph Gracie Pleasanton, we’re proud to offer a Jiu Jitsu class created especially for women. This class provides a welcoming and supportive environment where women of all ages and skill levels can feel safe, empowered, and confident while learning the art of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu.

In these classes, you’ll build strength, flexibility, and essential self-defense skills while also connecting with a community of women who share your goals. Our instructors ensure every student gets the guidance they need, whether you’re brand new to Jiu Jitsu or looking to sharpen your techniques.

Some women may wish to compete, and we’re always ready to help prepare you for that journey. But we also understand that not everyone is interested in competitions, and that’s okay too. We make sure that every woman gets the attention and support she deserves, so she can thrive in her own way.
Join us and experience the power of Jiu Jitsu — exclusively for women!

Here at Ralph Gracie Pleasanton, we are proud to offer Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, Muay Thai, MMA and Judo classes for all kids ages 3-16. Our 3-6 year olds get to have a fun experience learning their fundamentals throughout all classes, while they are also still learning how to listen, follow instructions, be respectful to others, and build confidence. These are lessons that follow through to our 7-10 year old classes, where they will be gaining a more in depth knowledge of the arts, and learn how to be able to stand up for themselves and others in a respectful manner. At this age, some students decide that they might want to participate in Jiu Jitsu competitions. We are always excited to give those who are interested in competing, an extra push to help get them ready and fully prepared. However, we also understand that not every child is interested in competing, and may not respond to that same type of "push". Therefore each student will get the same amount of attention, whether they are competitors or not, and will be helped to succeed in the way that makes them strive as an individual.
Professor Marcio Moreira - Main Black Belt

Professor Marcio Moreira was born and raised in Rio De Janeiro Brazil, where he started training in Jiu Jitsu at 8 years old. As a child, he trained under Professor Ricardo Delariva, later on he trained under Professor Alexandre "Soca" Freitas, from whom he received his blue belt. After that, he started training under Professor Paulo "Rabico" and Professor Roberto "Gordo" Correa where he earned his purple and brown belts, he then received his black belt at the age of 29 in 2012 from Professor David Vieira who was a black belt under Professor Carlinos Gracie and was teaching under Professor "Gordo" at that time. Professor Marcio has been a part of the Ralph Gracie team since 2017, and has owned and operated Ralph Gracie Pleasanton since 2019. Professor Marcio has had 3 professional fights and 4 amateur fights with a record of 7 wins and O losses. During his many years of training he has won multiple titles some notable ones being:

Professor Zack Johnson is a Jiu Jitsu black belt under Professor Marcio Moreira with over 8 years of experience at a competitive level. Over the years he has trained under many high-level Jiu Jitsu practitioners on the Ralph Gracie team, including Ralph Gracie, Rhalan Gracie, Eduardo Fraga, Felipe Jerry, Tony Souza, and has spent the last 3 years training under Professor Marcio Moreira. Coach Zack teaches our beginners fundamentals classes on Wednesdays and Fridays, where he focuses on building a strong foundation for those who are just starting their Jiu jitsu journey.

Professor Jay Radhakrishnan is a seasoned martial artist with over 15 years of competitive training experience. Holding a prestigious Black Belt and trains under the guidance of Professor Marcio Moreira. His mastery is deeply anchored in the esteemed tradition established by Ralph and Renzo Gracie. In New York, he refined his skills by training with renowned figures such as Joe D’Arce, Renzo Gracie, and Alex and Chris Vamos. Upon relocating to California, Jay advanced his craft at Heroes Martial Arts under the mentorship of Alan Marques Gumby, from whom he received his Black Belt in 2019. Since 2021, he has continued to deepen his proficiency under Professor Marcio Moreira. Today, leveraging his extensive competition background, Professor Jay leads our Saturday competition classes, inspiring and guiding the next generation of martial artists.

Coach Carlos Roa was born and raised in Caracas, Venezuela, where he developed a passion for sports, excelling in swimming and baseball. Throughout his early years, he competed in local, national, and international tournaments, with baseball being his primary focus. In 2021, he decided to explore Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and immediately developed a deep appreciation for the sport, its community, and the discipline it instills.
Since 2023, Coach Carlos has been a dedicated member of the Ralph Gracie team and is now a co-owner of the Ralph Gracie Pleasanton and Ralph Gracie San Ramon academies. Under the guidance of Professor Marcio, he was awarded his purple belt in October 2024.
Throughout his Jiu-Jitsu journey, Coach Carlos has achieved significant competitive success, earning multiple titles, including:

* 2nd Place – San Jose Spring International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2024 (Blue Belt GI)
* 2nd Place – Austin Summer International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2024 (Blue Belt GI)
* 2nd Place – Phoenix International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2024 (Blue Belt GI)
* 2nd Place – Tampa International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2024 (Purple Belt GI)
* 1st Place – Tampa International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2024 (Purple Belt NO GI)
* 1st Place – San Jose International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2025 (Purple Belt NO GI)
* 1st Place – San Jose International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2025 (Purple Belt GI)
* 2nd Place – San Jose International Open IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship 2025 (Purple Belt NO GI – Open Class)
* 1st Place - Sacramento International Open IBJJF Jiu Jitsu Championship 2025 (Purple Belt GI) 
* 2nd Place - Sacramento International Open IBJJF Jiu Jitsu Championship 2025 (Purple Belt GI - Open Class)
Coach Carlos remains committed to continuous improvement in the sport and strives to inspire others through his dedication to training, competition, and community building.

Coach Chris, an early adopter of martial arts, began his journey with Kenpo Karate, instilling discipline and technique. In high school, he expanded his skills by competing in wrestling and practicing judo, further deepening his understanding of grappling and body mechanics. However, it was at the age of 15 that he discovered his true passion—Brazilian Jiu Jitsu.

With nearly a decade of experience, he has honed his skills and joined the esteemed Ralph Gracie team over the past three years, under the guidance of Professor Marcio Moreira. His extensive knowledge of Jiu Jitsu stems from learning from some of the sport’s greatest minds, including renowned martial artist Dave Camarillo and former UFC fighter Marcel Fortuna.
With experience as both a practitioner and instructor, Coach Chris teaches classes for adults and children, fostering a strong foundation of skills, confidence, perseverance, and respect.
Coach Chris’s unwavering passion for Jiu Jitsu is evident in his teaching style. He dedicates himself to the craft, his students, and the growth of the Jiu Jitsu community.

Ralph Zavala Jr. is a dedicated martial artist and coach from the Bay Area, with two years of experience training and competing in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and MMA. Training out of Ralph Gracie Pleasanton, Ralph holds a blue belt and has earned several competitive accolades in both jiu-jitsu and amateur MMA.
• Blue Belt under Ralph Gracie (since Jan 2024)
• Bronze Medalist, 2025 IBJJF San Diego Spring International Open (Featherweight, Adult Division)
• Gold Medalist, Ralph Gracie In-House Tournament (2024)
• Silver Medalist, All-Star Jiu-Jitsu Tournament (2024, No-Gi Featherweight)
• Victories at First Round Fights 2 and Zhong Luo Cage Fighting Series 10

Ralph coaches both kids and adults with a focus on technique, discipline, and building confidence. His hands-on experience as a competitor brings valuable insights to every class, encouraging students to develop both their skills and mindset. Ralph believes martial arts is more than just fighting—it’s a path to personal growth.
“Discipline is what got me here, but teaching is what keeps me going.”
Whether you’re new to martial arts or training for competition, Ralph’s coaching will help you build real strength, confidence, and resilience.
At Ralph Gracie Pleasanton, we offer Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, No Gi, and Muay Thai classes for both adults and kids—starting as young as 3 years old!
We’d love to welcome you in for a free 3-day trial so you can meet our team, experience our classes, and see what makes our community so special.
If you have any questions, feel free to call or text us at (925) 918-5359—we’re happy to help!
